svg.title: RadVision AI system architecture — complete pipeline
svg.desc: Black and white flowchart showing the RadVision AI pipeline: chest X-ray input through Flask backend, image preprocessing, CheXNet DenseNet-121 inference, GradCAM localization, Findings JSON. Findings branch right to Claude Sonnet API for report generation. Both paths feed the React frontend which renders annotated, enhanced, and segmented views, and produces a PDF report output.
